**SECTION C - CLAIMANT ALLEGATIONS**

The claimant, a 58-year-old male, alleges inability to work beginning August 15, 2022, due to conditions including severe right hip pain, history of shoulder and back problems, and hypertension. He reports that pain in his right hip made it impossible to stand or walk for more than a few minutes at a time. He states he underwent a right hip replacement which has helped, but he still has significant limitations. He reports difficulty lifting, carrying, bending, and squatting. He also mentions a history of a shoulder injury and back issues from many years ago that still cause him problems. Daily activities are limited; he reports needing help with shopping, cleaning, and cooking. He states he can no longer engage in hobbies like gardening or fishing.

**SECTION D - MEDICAL EVIDENCE OF RECORD**

**EXHIBIT 1F: Records from Wellness Consultants Ltd**
MER Received 10-11-2023. A report from a magnetic resonance imaging study performed on 2013-03-15 provides historical context for the claimant's musculoskeletal complaints. The imaging of the right shoulder revealed a large, complex partial-thickness tear involving the distal rotator cuff tendon, which was superimposed with a small full-thickness tear. Abnormal signal in the bone marrow of the superolateral humeral head was noted, possibly reflecting a contusion where the tendon attaches at the tuberosity. A Grade 2 SLAP tear was identified in the anterior glenoid labrum. Concurrent imaging of the cervical spine demonstrated a right-sided paracentral disc herniation at the C4-C5 level, resulting in right-sided foraminal narrowing. A lumbar spine MRI was also performed, which showed a right paracentral disc herniation at the L5-S1 level. No surgical intervention is documented in relation to these findings.

**EXHIBIT 2F: Records from Metro Health & Wellness Center**
FAX RECEIVED: 10/15/2023 14:30. These records span multiple visits. On an examination dated 2022-09-15, the claimant was seen for hip pain. He was noted to be sitting in a chair without apparent distress and reported that rest improved his discomfort. He was ambulating without any assistive device. His weight was recorded as 69.85 kilograms with a BMI of 24.9. Blood pressure was one-twenty-six over eighty-six. Gait and coordination
